# ceph_pools (Data Source)

Lists all Ceph pools.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ceph_pools" "all" {}

output "pool_names" {
  value = [for p in data.ceph_pools.all.pools : p.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `pools` (Attributes List) All pools in the cluster. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pools))

<a id="nestedatt--pools"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pools`

Read-Only:

- `application_metadata` (Set of String) Applications enabled on the pool.
- `crush_rule` (String) CRUSH rule name.
- `min_size` (Number) Minimum number of replicas required for I/O.
- `name` (String) Pool name.
- `pg_autoscale_mode` (String) Placement group autoscale mode.
- `pg_num` (Number) Number of placement groups.
- `pool_id` (Number) Numeric pool identifier.
- `pool_type` (String) Pool type: replicated or erasure.
- `quota_max_bytes` (Number) Maximum bytes quota (0 = unlimited).
- `quota_max_objects` (Number) Maximum objects quota (0 = unlimited).
- `size` (Number) Number of replicas.
